mentions.name: Webhound
mentions.description: This tool performs budget-controlled, long-running deep research: users set a budget and Webhound spends that amount on compute/LLM tokens to research a prompt, with built-in verification cycles, optional added verification budget, and every claim cited with evidence and a direct link to the tool calls that produced it. It is aimed at actual researchers.
